capabilities: Generate Markdown in notes from JavaScript expressions
Query note metadata with Dataview's dv object
Reuse Templater user scripts and functions
Run async operations like data fetching
Configure ignored folders and ending tag metadata
extras: README warns the plugin is under early development and the syntax may change, though it aims to stay backward compatible; it recommends pairing with CodeblockCustomizer for collapsing run blocks.
problem: Obsidian notes are static, so there is no built-in way to compute and render generated Markdown inside a note from code or metadata queries.

relations.evidence: you can access the dv object if you have dataview plugin installed
you can access the tp object if you have templater plugin installed and enabled
install this plugin and install obsidian-custom-save
You can use it with CodeblockCustomizer, to have folding codeblock

summary: Run block plugin that generates Markdown content in notes from JavaScript expressions and Dataview queries at save time.
